response:
Because when the run starts the blimp is touching/overlapping the curved arch, the engine resolves that contact by pushing it off along the arch’s tangent. That gives it a horizontal component of velocity, so it moves diagonally instead of straight up. 

Fixes: place the blimp a little above the arch (not touching the curve) or move it to a flat surface so it gains no lateral push at start.
